title: chromolaena foliata
intro: Chromolaena foliata, commonly known as Mexican mint or tree marigold, is a plant species in the sunflower family that is native to Mexico and Central America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms of digestive issues and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Chromolaena foliata include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The plant's leaves and flowers have been used to treat fever, coughs, and skin conditions, demonstrating its potential as a natural remedy for various health issues.
